desktop.notes:
• Updates from inside Cullect work again. In beta.12 the check always said "no internet" (the signature check could not start in the portable build). Install this version once by hand; later updates come in by themselves.
• beta.13's dashboard, quick buttons, menu, slideshow keys and Send to Curish change, now together with beta.12's speed work and signed updates (beta.13 had left those out).
